listing.listingDescription: Vintage Kodak Brownie Hawkeye Flash Model box camera in used condition. This classic mid-20th century black box camera features the original metal label plate reading 'BROWNIE Kodak HAWKEYE CAMERA Flash MODEL' and the Kodak logo, confirming its identity. The camera has visible surface wear and some dirt, with no visibly missing components. The side winding knob, large ribbed lens, and top viewfinder are intact. Exact year of manufacture and mechanical condition are unverified. An excellent collectible for vintage camera enthusiasts and Kodak camera collectors. Sold as-is without accessories or flash attachments. Please review photos carefully and ask any questions before purchasing.
